name: edge
description: Cloudflare Worker that serves the built SPA bundle and proxies the API paths to the origin, keeping both on one hostname

scripts.assets: test -d ../frontend/dist || { echo 'apps/frontend/dist is missing - run `pnpm --filter frontend build` first' >&2; exit 1; }; rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp -R ../frontend/dist/. dist/
